phraseology

A traffic circuit in English, out loud

Recorded on the online demo: Whisper small.en hears the pilot, rules check the readback, Piper speaks for the tower. The pilot's voice is synthetic too, with a French accent, so you can hear the whole loop. The waits while the server transcribes are cut.

Open models on your own laptop: Whisper hears, Piper speaks. No language model: the rules decide.

A practice game, not training. Your instructor and your national authority's manual are the reference.
